hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
err=$(git ls-files -z -mo --exclude-standard -- '*.jl' 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 -r julia -e 'using JuliaFormatter; foreach(format, ARGS)' -- 2>&1 >/dev/null) || true
[ -z "$err" ] || { printf 'JuliaFormatter: %s\n' "$err" >&2; exit 1; }
exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
bin=web/node_modules/.bin/prettier
[ -x "$bin" ] || exit 0
err=$(git ls-files -z -mo --exclude-standard -- 'web/*.ts' 'web/*.tsx' 'web/*.css' 'web/*.json' 'web/*.html' ':!:web/package-lock.json' 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 -r "$bin" --write --log-level warn 2>&1 >/dev/null) || true
[ -z "$err" ] || { printf 'prettier: %s\n' "$err" >&2; exit 1; }
exit 0
